translation:
Avoid eating hot things and provoking foods. If the blood flows without stopping and there is no eating or drinking for three days, the brain and marrow must be stirred; it is not suitable to treat it. <ins>Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏)</ins> (see the Lingyun bone injury)
<ins>Dao Qi Tong Yu Ding (導氣通瘀錠)</ins> (see the crown bone injury)
<ins>Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹)</ins> (see the mountain-corner bone injury)
<ins>Ba Xian Xiao Yao Tang (八仙逍遙湯)</ins> (see the Yuliang bone injury)
